versions.subject: Merge PR #4577 from @nasbench - Multiple Fixes & Updates
versions.detection:
selection_main_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\whoami.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'whoami.exe'
selection_main_cli:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ' -all'
        - ' /all'
condition: all of selection_main_*

versions.subject: Merge PR #4752 from @frack113 - Update rules to use the `windash` modifier
versions.detection:
selection_main_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\whoami.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'whoami.exe'
selection_main_cli:
    CommandLine|contains|windash: ' -all'
condition: all of selection_main_*
versions.spl: Image="*\\whoami.exe" OR OriginalFileName="whoami.exe" CommandLine="* -all*" OR CommandLine="* /all*" OR CommandLine="* –all*" OR CommandLine="* —all*" OR CommandLine="* ―all*"
